name: Parallel Chunk Voxelization with Early Quit
definition: Distributes per-chunk voxelization across multiple threads using Rayon, with atomic counters tracking early termination conditions and a channel to stream results to the main thread.
summary: Parallel Chunk Voxelization with Early Quit accelerates mesh-to-voxel conversion by distributing work across threads and skipping empty chunks to avoid unnecessary processing.
